neighbours.label: subword pieces 'if', 'iffer' or 'pher' inside split words (scient|if|iques, P|fe|iffer, s|pher|oid)
fire: Les revues spécifiques publient ces travaux chaque mois.
Ce résultat a été démontré scientifiquement en 2010.
His back felt stiffer after the long flight.
The airport sniffer dog found the hidden package.
The reporter interviewed Professor Schiffer about the dig.
The spy wrote his letters in a simple cypher.
The planet is a slightly flattened spheroid.
Spheroidal graphite iron is used for heavy pipes.
quiet: Les revues médicales publient ces travaux chaque mois.
Ce résultat a été démontré clairement en 2010.
His back felt worse after the long flight.
The airport security dog found the hidden package.
The reporter interviewed Professor Griffin about the dig.
The spy tried to decipher the letters in a code.
The planet is a slightly flattened sphere.
Spherical graphite particles are used for heavy pipes.

notes: Spelling unit. Card: 'if' x8, 'pher' x6, 'iff' x4, 'iffer' x2. Probe: scientifiques 0.92, spheroidal 0.92, Pfeiffer 0.82; whole-token ' scientific' 0.05. Fire words chosen so the piece is its own token; near misses use single-token words (spherical, hemisphere, scientific, differ, Griffin, Christopher, decipher, amplifier).
